prespermatid.translation: [医] 前精细胞, 次级精母细胞

presphenoid.definition:
a. Situated in front of the sphenoid bone; of or
   pertaining to the anterior part of the sphenoid bone (i. e., the
   presphenoid bone).
n. The presphenoid bone.

presphygmic period.translation: [医] 脉搏前期, 等长收缩期(心)

presplitting.translation: 预裂法(岩石开挖的方法)

presponse.definition:
To respond to a question before it is finished, often confusing the asker.
> Wendy: So are you avail-
> Jimmy: No. (Presponse)
> Wendy: -ible Monday?
> (silence)
> Wendy: Are you?
